name: Christening
overview: Christening, as revealed in Scripture, is the act of baptism that follows repentance and faith in Jesus Christ, signifying the washing away of sins and the reception of the Holy Spirit. Jesus commands making disciples through baptism in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, highlighting its essential role in the believer’s entrance into the kingdom of God. The early church practiced baptism immediately upon receiving the gospel, demonstrating its integral connection to salvation and new birth in Christ.
